name: Verify assistant handles concurrent messages gracefully
objective: Validate no errors when messages are sent rapidly

steps.description: Send 3 messages rapidly in quick succession
steps.testData: Message 1: Hello | Message 2: Help me | Message 3: What can you do?
steps.expectedResult: All 3 messages are sent without error

steps.description: Verify all messages are processed by the assistant
steps.expectedResult: All 3 messages receive responses from the assistant

steps.description: Verify no error messages or UI glitches are displayed
steps.expectedResult: No errors, crashes, or UI anomalies are present
